title: Faceless CRM
summary: A CRM for solo operators and AI-first agencies who never want to see a 'contact' record. Notes, calls, and emails flow in; the system surfaces the next best action as a one-line nudge with a draft reply. The user only ever sees prose, not pipelines.
targetMarket: Solo founders, indie consultants, micro-agencies (1–5 people) running on Gmail/Outlook + a notes app. Annual revenue $50k–$2M. AI-fluent, allergic to Salesforce-style data entry.
wedge: Zero forms, zero pipeline stages, zero required fields. Everything is inferred from message history. The product writes the next email; the user edits it.
businessModelHypothesis: B2C-style PLG SaaS: $29/mo solo, $79/mo team. Trial → paid in <14 days. CAC <$120 via founder content + integrations marketplace.
founderAssumptions: Solo operators hate CRM data entry and abandon traditional CRMs within 30 days.
An AI that drafts the next reply is more valuable than a dashboard.
Integration with Gmail + Calendar is sufficient for 80% of the target market.
Users will trust an LLM to read their inbox if data stays in their tenant.
Pricing at <$30/mo removes the 'do I need this?' objection for solo users.
